entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: mixed operand is not admitted for %s at %s
entries.rationale: This is an internal registration invariant for scalar(), not a rejection of an admitted query shape. lowerScalarMixedOperand calls requireFloatScalarPolicy with the scalar operand-admission key before the original loader; scalarFloatRows checks the scalar existing-plan key only for a mixed operand. Both production rows in mixedOperandPolicies are executable float-only. The table has no query-controlled or external configuration. Ordinary float and histogram-only operands bypass this mixed check. Missing rows and reject, bespoke, or preserve modes are exercised only by synthetic calls or temporary table mutation in the authority tests.
